subject: 🏃 Tuesday — 6×800m Track Intervals (Wk 2)
html:
Tomorrow: 6×800m Track Intervals — Week 2, Phase 1 Foundation (11 weeks to race day)

The workout: 1.9 mi easy jog to the track, 6×800m at 7:00–7:10 pace (5K effort — your VO2 ceiling), 90 sec recovery jog between reps, 1.9 mi easy jog home. Total ~7–8 mi with warm-up and cool-down.

Pre-run activation (5 min before you leave the house): Quadruped hip CARs (3 each direction, each leg), banded lateral walks (10 each), glute bridges (10 reps), then the PT-prescribed quadruped banded hip IR (5–10 reps each side).

Context: This is a step up from last week's 5×1000m — one more rep, shorter distance, same pace band. Week 1 closed out with every session at knee 1/5 and 8+ travel miles in Victoria on Saturday with only a brief 1.5/5 stretching blip. You're entering the volume bump from 17 to 24 miles this week, with Bay to Breakers on Sunday as the first fast-finish benchmark.

Focus cue: Lock into 7:00–7:10 from the first rep — don't let the shorter 800m distance tempt you into running 6:45. The goal is controlled VO2 stimulus, not a kick. If the last two reps feel the same as the first two, you nailed it.

Prep: Lay out your track kit tonight, set the alarm for 5:30 AM. Hydrate well before bed — you ran hard Saturday and the Monday circuit was active recovery, so legs should feel fresh. Get to bed by 10.
